articles.title: A Glowing Rocket Engine That Could Speed Us to Mars
articles.summary: NASA just fired a super-hot engine that runs on metal vapor. It reached 120 kilowatts—25 times more powerful than current space engines. This is a big step toward sending astronauts to Mars.

articles.title: This Tiny Pond Creature Rewrote the Rules of DNA
articles.summary: Scientists found a microscopic organism in a pond that uses DNA in a way never seen before. It changed the meaning of two stop signals in its genetic code—something thought impossible.

articles.title: This Nail Polish Turns Your Fingernails Into a Phone Stylus
articles.summary: A new clear nail polish could let people with long nails use touchscreens easily. It contains taurine, a safe supplement, that disrupts the screen's electric field when you tap.
